chapter: Joining Earl Hines and the Grand Terrace
title: How Hines became Fatha
summary: Announcer Ted Pearson began calling him Father Hines on air.

story.theme_name: Radio and television work: staff jobs, shows and broadcasts
story.community_name: Working radio and television: network shows, studio staffs, talk-show bands

blocks.x: Were you in the band the night that he got his nickname?
Yeah. Well, that was on the broadcast. Yeah. Because I was with the band before we started broadcasting.
The broadcasts started in '32. I joined the band in '31, and the broadcasts started in '32.
I was looking in Earl Hines book last night, and just skimming through it I saw the story about the announcer --
Yeah, he's the one started calling him "Father" Hines.
Earl "Fatha" Hines. I don't know where he got that father from. Then after he'd make the announcement, then George Dixon's the one started hollering, "Father Hines, Father Hines."
Oh, he's the one that did that?
Yeah, he's the one did that.
